title: Node2Shell: Taking Over a Server with a Single Compressed Data File (CVE-2026-111497)
content_md: Overview CVE-2026-111497, disclosed in October 2026, is an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Brotli decoder included in Node.js. Brotli is a compression algorithm developed by Google, primarily used to compress web transmission data or to decompress transmitted compressed data.
